results.title: Ruckus in J&K Assembly over resolution, LoP Sharma again seeks Speaker's removal, I know my powers: Speaker reacts
results.description: Chaos erupted in the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly as LoP Sunil Sharma renews calls for Speaker Abdul Rahim Rather's removal over the controversial statehood and autonomy resolution.
